blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Brale explicitly supports denylist/freeze/clawback for token programs. Its security page reports multi-party issuer-key control and threshold signing, SOC 2 Type II, annual AML/BSA audits and annual penetration testing. These are issuer-reported program-level controls, not a retrieved USTX-specific audit. USTX-specific enabled implementation, role holders and signing threshold are not disclosed; capability expectation only.
